notes: Text-readable PDF (Frontiers in Medicine 2025, DOI 10.3389/fmed.2025.1571231), SRM Chennai, Jul 2022-Jul 2024, 8,359 non-duplicate GNB; 24% (2,007) carbapenem-resistant. CRITICAL CAVEAT: All susceptibility values extracted apply ONLY to the carbapenem-resistant (CRO) subset, NOT to all clinical isolates, section 3.6 and Figure 5 explicitly report 'resistance patterns of CROs to various antibacterial agents.' So these %S are far lower than a general antibiogram; the n values used (E.coli 433, K.pneumoniae 733, P.aeruginosa 290, A.baumannii 388) are the carbapenem-resistant isolate counts. Source reports %RESISTANT throughout; I converted every cell to %S = 100 - R (from_R:true). Values taken from narrative text on page 5 (section 3.6); Figure 5 is a heat map image (not machine-readable) and Supplementary Table 2 is not in this PDF, so only the explicitly-printed numeric %R values were extracted.
